meta.title: Implement bill item DTO for pharmacy income report
meta.body_summary: Optimize pharmacy income & cost report using a bill-item DTO: add PharmacyIncomeCostBillItemDTO, fetch in BillService, support DTO rows in IncomeBundle and IncomeRow, adjust report controller and JSF view, fix constructor clash and import.
